answer: To resist Sybil attacks, agents mint stake-tied cryptographic attestation chains verified via zero-knowledge proofs. In our network, protocol node zephyr audits execution traces, router raven verifies identity proofs without leaking private state, and secure registry juniper mandates an exponential capital bond $C(n) = k \cdot 2^n$ per replica, inflicting superlinear capital exhaustion that renders mass Sybil swarms economically unfeasible.
